Most Likely To Questions

90 Most Likely To party questions — draw, shuffle, and vote on who fits each one.

Press Draw to reveal the first question.

90 questions left in the deck

📖 How to use

  1. Press Draw a Question.
  2. Everyone points at who is most likely.
  3. Press Shuffle Deck for a fresh order anytime.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do you play?

90 lighthearted questions like 'Most likely to survive on a desert island?' — vote by pointing at the person who fits.

Do questions repeat?

Draw deals the next question without repeating; Shuffle resets the whole deck.

How many are left?

The counter shows how many questions remain in the current deck.
